Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference

Application-Defined Message Functions

This section describes the message handlers you use to process messages from the Telephone Manager. You must register your message handlers with the Telephone Manager as described in "Registering Message Handlers" on page 5-49. When you register a message handler, you specify which messages it should receive.
